ExtraDock 5.1.0 - AI Help, Connected Apps & Docks That Get Out of the Way! 🤖🔗✨

✨ What's New

  • Configure ExtraDock with an AI assistant: The new Settings → Integrations → AI Assistants (MCP) section lets assistants like Claude Code or Codex inspect and arrange your docks, items and widgets. It stays off until you turn on Allow AI assistants to configure ExtraDock, and Install or Update Skill adds the bundled ExtraDock Assistant skill in one click!
  • You stay in control: Deleting docks or items asks for your approval first. Allow for This Session approves the rest of that assistant's changes until it disconnects, YOLO mode (off by default) skips the prompts, and Revert Last AI Change undoes the most recent AI edit without touching changes you made afterwards!
  • Connect your Appit Studio apps: ExtraDock, ExtraBar and DockFlow now find each other automatically in a new Talk Integrations library at the top of Settings → Integrations, with no pairing codes. Approve a connection once and it reconnects on its own after restarts, and Permissions… and Remove… let you review or take back access at any time!
  • Hide on Window Hover: A new toggle in each dock's Behavior settings fades the dock out as soon as another app's window overlaps it, and brings it back once the area stays clear. Clicks pass through to the window underneath, and the show/toggle hotkey still brings the dock up whenever you need it!
  • Refreshed widget library: Search widgets, browse by category and use Configure and Add…, with new artwork for launchers, folders, shelves, Space Awareness, Stripe and more. Clock, CPU and Media Player are redrawn too!
  • Pinned position controls are back: The Position tab has an Advanced group again for pinned docks, with Offset along edge plus Top, Right, Bottom and Left padding!

🛠️ Improvements

  • Liquid Glass that always looks right: The bar now uses the same glass as the macOS Dock. It no longer turns into a frosted blur when another app has focus, and switching to Liquid Glass while ExtraDock is running looks exactly like it does after a relaunch!
  • Clearer glass option: The Liquid Glass toggle that darkens the dock background is now called Dark glass. Your existing setting is kept!
  • Virtual Trash retired from the library: It can no longer be added, but docks that already have one keep it and it still works!

What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraDock more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraDock community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
